verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss's pricing page lists calendar sync as a product feature ("Sync your calendar & email"), so the core capability is first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows that synced meetings appear on contact or deal timelines, or how the sync works. Missing for 10: documentation that synced meetings appear on contact timelines, documentation of deal-timeline association, details of supported calendar providers and sync direction, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync my calendar so meetings appear on contact and deal timelines
